paragraphs.text: Vibranium is an artifact type and predefined token introduced in Marvel Super Heroes Commander .

Vibranium is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. It is an indestructible metal with an extraordinary ability to absorb, store, and release large amounts of kinetic energy. It is mainly associated with the Kingdom of Wakanda , where it’s primarily located. It is notably used by the Black Panther , whose suit is made of vibranium, and Captain America , whose shield is infused with some vibranium.

Each Vibranium token has the artifact subtype “Vibranium”, is Indestructible , and the ability “ : Add . This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.” This ability is shared by Powerstones . All generators of this token create tapped versions.
A Universes Within equivalent of Vibranium would be Darksteel metal .
